reasons: The single insertion supplies every atomic preferred element: professional and workmanlike Services, documentation conformance for software/deliverables (12 months) and Services (90 days from performance), compliance with laws, no malicious code, and repair/replacement/refund remedies.
No re-performance carve-out, no new exceptions, and no broadening language was added; the Y2K warranty, evidence/repair mechanic and the disclaimer paragraph are untouched and remain effective.

Concise insertion into a clause that previously contained only a Y2K warranty is the minimal fix; no defined terms are left dangling ('Services', 'Interface' are used consistently with the agreement).
